California Sea Lion and Brandt’s Cormorant Spotted at Pillar Point Harbor

On 19th September 2026 at 10:10 AM, observers recorded marine wildlife at Pillar Point Harbor, CA, US.

🔍 Overview

  • Date: 19th September 2026
  • Time: 10:10 AM
  • Location: Pillar Point Harbor, California, USA

🐾 Species observed

  • California Sea Lion
  • Brandt’s Cormorant
  • Northern Gannet (named Morris) – noted peeking from behind the base of a sign after the photo was taken

📸 Observation details

item.title: Kākāpō Population Increases Following Record Breeding Season
item.description:
Kākāpō Population Increases Following Record Breeding Season

📊 Population Update

The total population of the kākāpō has reached 325 individuals as of 31st August 2026. This increase follows a record breeding season, with this year’s chicks having now matured into juveniles.

💡 Historical Context

  • 1995: 51 kākāpō remaining
  • 31st August 2026: 325 kākāpō recorded

#kakapo #conservation #wildlife

Source: A quote from Andrew Digby
